description: Implementation of the FakeServiceManager class, a mock or stub version of a service manager used in Android, providing methods to add, check, list, and manage services.

classes.name: FakeServiceManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of a service manager for testing or stub purposes.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns a service binder for the given service name.

methods.name: checkService
methods.description: Checks if a service with the given name exists and returns its binder.

methods.name: addService
methods.description: Adds a service binder with the specified name to the manager.

methods.name: listServices
methods.description: Returns a list of all service names registered.

methods.name: onAsBinder
methods.description: Returns a binder interface for the service manager itself.

methods.name: waitForService
methods.description: Waits for and returns a service binder for the given name.

methods.name: isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if a service with the given name is declared.

methods.name: getDeclaredInstances
methods.description: Returns instances of services declared with a specific prefix.

methods.name: updatableViaApex
methods.description: Checks if a service can be updated via APEX; returns nullopt.

methods.name: getUpdatableNames
methods.description: Returns names of services updatable via APEX.

methods.name: getConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection info for a service.

methods.name: registerForNotifications
methods.description: Registers for service notifications; returns INVALID_OPERATION.

methods.name: unregisterForNotifications
methods.description: Unregisters from service notifications; returns INVALID_OPERATION.
